gate: AUD3 gap 5, offline unit checks; no runtime gate passed

finding.before: kmzShape made a ZIP a KMZ when any member probed as KML and every other member was a KML or had an image/model suffix, without checking that a KML references it; several KML documents were accepted. queueZipLayersTx skips kmz and the native reader reads one KML, so the other KMLs and an unrelated plan photo stayed only inside the archive
finding.after: kmzShape: a KMZ is exactly one KML document, at the root or named doc.kml, and only images or models that KML references by relative path (read from the KML's bounded 64 KiB probe head: element href/targetHref and href/src attributes; web links, absolute paths and paths leaving the archive name no member; nothing fetched) or that sit in the files/ folder beside it that it references. Otherwise the archive stays a ZIP with the words 'Not read as a KMZ: <reason>; each member is taken out as its own item.' and the existing ZP1 fan-out takes out every member: each KML goes to the KML reader, a photo becomes a page-image item. No photo is read as a footprint
